_notes: Monthly estimates, 2026 rates. The script ignores this key.
Pay: 40,000 kr gross. Danish median for restaurant managers is 40,911 kr (DST via tiderne.dk); Goodjob puts an experienced McDonald's restaurant manager at 40-50k kr.

Tax: Copenhagen municipal 23.39%, bottom tax 12.01% and 8% AM-bidrag; personal allowance 54,100 kr, employment deduction 12.75% (max 63,300 kr), job deduction 3,100 kr. No church tax; below the middle-tax threshold.
Pension: assumed 4% employee share plus 99 kr ATP. A-kasse 500 kr (Ma-kasse lists 562 kr for 2026); it is tax-deductible.
UK student loan: Plan 2, 9% of gross above £29,385. Denmark's 2026-27 overseas threshold is not yet checked against the gov.uk table.
Copenhagen costs: 1-bed rent 12,000 kr (sources say 9,000-13,100), groceries 3,500, heating/power/water 900, monthly pass 460, phone and internet 300, going out 1,500.

Student loans, Denmark: SU grant 7,426 kr/month before tax in 2026 for students living away from home (lovguiden.dk) = £829; tuition free for Danish/EU students; average SU debt 57,000-68,000 kr for 2020-21 graduates (Statistics Denmark) = £6,400-7,600.

Student loans, UK: England fee cap £9,790 for 2026/27 (gov.uk); maintenance support is a loan; average balance entering repayment £47,730 in 2025-26 (Student Loans Company). Your repayment on this job: Plan 2 on £37,000 in the UK = £57/month; on 40,000 kr in Denmark = £181/month.
deductions: Income tax, nine and a half thousand.

loans.title: STUDENT LOANS
loans.subtitle: Denmark vs the UK
loans.say: Now here's the twist. Student loans.

rows.label: Uni tuition fees
rows.say: Uni in Denmark is free. In the UK, it's nine thousand seven hundred and ninety pounds a year.

rows.label: Paid while studying
rows.say: Danish students are paid about eight hundred pounds a month to study. UK students get loans.

rows.label: Average debt after uni
rows.say: Danish grads owe about seven thousand pounds. UK grads, nearly forty eight thousand.

rows.label: Your UK loan on this job
rows.say: But your UK loan costs more over there. A hundred and eighty one pounds a month, not fifty seven.

vo.globe: What does a McDonald's manager take home in
vo.hook: Let's break down the tax, the bills, and what you keep.
vo.pay: A McDonald's manager in Copenhagen earns about forty thousand kroner a month. Around four and a half thousand pounds.
vo.take_home: That leaves twenty three thousand six hundred. About two thousand six hundred pounds.
vo.left: So what's left? Just under five thousand kroner. About five hundred and fifty pounds a month.
vo.question: So, would you move to Denmark? Comment the next job and country.
